summary: Hezbollah launched an explosive drone at Israeli forces in southern Lebanon's Ali Taher Ridge while the IDF withheld publication citing operational security. Simultaneously, infiltration alerts triggered lockdowns in West Bank settlements Ofra and Ofarim, and a fence breach was detected at Zikim near Gaza. Yemen's Houthis attacked government forces in Marib and Hadramawt, killing two and wounding 14, prompting UN warning of highest war renewal risk since 2022.

Zikim residents near Gaza ordered to shelter following discovery of a fence breach; security scans underway. (Source: @almogboker78/17915)
Houthi attacks in Yemen's Marib and Hadramawt killed two and wounded 14; UN envoy warns of highest risk of full-scale war since 2022 ceasefire. (Source: @N12chat/221079)

Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed the Mecca Agreement joint defense pact citing Iranian proxy threats. (Source: @mamlekate/104097)
US CENTCOM diverted 51 commercial vessels, disabled two, and inspected two since resuming blockade of Iranian ports. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78916)
Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal recorded zero tanker loadings for a week, the longest disruption since war began per satellite imagery. (Source: @kianmeli1/90717)

sections.threat_assessment: Hezbollah's use of an explosive drone in southern Lebanon signals continued willingness to test Israeli air defenses despite the ceasefire, while the IDF's selective disclosure suggests operational sensitivity around force protection. Simultaneous infiltration attempts in the West Bank and at the Gaza fence indicate persistent militant intent to breach perimeters. The Houthi escalation in Yemen, coupled with the UN's stark warning, raises the prospect of a renewed multi-front conflict involving Iranian proxies. The US naval blockade of Iranian ports and the Mecca Agreement defense pact reflect a hardening regional alignment against Iranian maritime and proxy activities.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have formalized a collective defense pact explicitly referencing Iranian proxy threats, marking a significant Sunni bloc consolidation. The UAE's ADNOC openly acknowledges repeated attacks on its shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring Gulf energy infrastructure vulnerability. The United States conditions lifting its Iranian port blockade on an Oman-Iran agreement, linking diplomatic progress to maritime security. Meanwhile, the Kurdistan Regional Government aligns with Baghdad's push to monopolize weapons, reflecting internal Iraqi pressure to curb militia autonomy.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iran's recovery of intact US MQ-9 Reaper and Israeli Hermes 900 drones provides the IRGC with high-value technical intelligence for reverse-engineering advanced UAV capabilities. The OFAC sanctions network targeting Shahr Bank's UAE-based exchange houses and shell companies in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Dubai reveals a sophisticated financial infrastructure moving hundreds of millions for the IRGC-QF and allied militias. The week-long halt at Kharg Island, Iran's primary oil export terminal, indicates the blockade's tangible impact on revenue. Hamas's continued tunnel and munitions reconstruction during the ceasefire suggests preparation for future hostilities regardless of diplomatic tracks.
